author: Praxis V
title: PBVE‑lite + Scaled PCA60 — scanpy.neighbors graph on X_emb (k=50, cosine)
abstract: Scaled‑PCA (gene-wise std, zero_center=False) + PBVE‑lite embedding, with neighbors built via scanpy.neighbors (k=50, cosine) on X_emb to avoid custom weighted kNN pathologies. Returns X_emb and CSR connectivities/distances.
